name: Dynamic Diffuse Global Illumination (DDGI)
definition: A Global Illumination technique using a 3D grid array of very low resolution cubemaps (e.g., 4x4), built using raytracing or cone tracing, with a second depth cubemap to prevent light/shadow leaks.
summary: DDGI is a real-time diffuse global illumination technique using persistent ray-traced probes to adapt to geometry changes, offering O(1) complexity and low memory usage without specular support.
